Issue Number: close #40101, ref #49786

Problem Summary:
This PR allows the coordinator to push the GC safepoint into PD.

### What is changed and how it works?
This PR added a new interface for `TiKVClusterMeta` named `BlockGCUntil`, which would set a GC safepoint for log backup.

issue_context.title: log-backup: let the coordinator upload the service safepoint
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement
For some historical reasons, each TiKV uploads the service GC safepoint by theirselves, which is a little redundant.
We can move it to the coordinator.

review_comments: When the current checkpoint TS is lower than the GC safepoint (which is rare).
Will it lost data here when the current checkpoint TS is lower than the GC safepoint?
Probably. Perhaps we need to issue some fatal error then. 🤔
(Maybe in another PR we should introduce TiDB-side fatal errors.)
